q_A: SELECT museum_id , name FROM museum ORDER BY num_of_staff DESC LIMIT 1
gold_q_B: SELECT "museum"."Museum_ID" AS "museum_id", "museum"."Name" AS "name" FROM "museum" AS "museum" ORDER BY "museum"."staff_num" DESC LIMIT 1

q_A: SELECT avg(num_of_staff) FROM museum WHERE open_year < 2009
gold_q_B: SELECT AVG("museum"."staff_num") AS "_col_0" FROM "museum" AS "museum" WHERE "museum"."Open_Year" < 2009

q_A: SELECT Num_of_Staff , Open_Year FROM museum WHERE name = 'Plaza Museum'
gold_q_B: SELECT "museum"."staff_num" AS "num_of_staff", "museum"."Open_Year" AS "open_year" FROM "museum" AS "museum" WHERE "museum"."Name" = 'Plaza Museum'

q_A: SELECT name FROM museum WHERE num_of_staff > (SELECT min(num_of_staff) FROM museum WHERE open_year > 2010)
gold_q_B: SELECT "museum"."Name" AS "name" FROM "museum" AS "museum" WHERE "museum"."staff_num" > (SELECT MIN("museum"."staff_num") AS "_col_0" FROM "museum" AS "museum" WHERE "museum"."Open_Year" > 2010)

q_A: SELECT t1.name , t1.age FROM visitor AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.visitor_id ORDER BY t2.num_of_ticket DESC LIMIT 1
gold_q_B: SELECT "t1"."Name" AS "name", "t1"."Age" AS "age" FROM "visitor" AS "t1" JOIN "visit" AS "t2" ON "t1"."ID" = "t2"."visitor_ID" ORDER BY "t2"."coupon_quantity" DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG("visit"."coupon_quantity") AS "_col_0", MAX("visit"."coupon_quantity") AS "_col_1" FROM "visit" AS "visit"
